subject.title: Westside Union School District Board of Trustees

text: Occupation: Westside Union Governing Board Member

I have been your representative on the Westside Governing Board since 2005, with many accomplishments. All 12 Westside schools have received the Western Association of Schools and Colleges (WASC) accreditation. Westside has 5
Distinguished Schools and I have dedicated 3 new schools. We survived the GREAT RECESSION with
We continue to recruit the best and brightest staff and as a result, we have
We have the highest scores in the Antelope Valley.
I am fiscally responsible and have a proven track record as a leader.

I promised that there was no room in our classrooms for politics and I have kept that pledge. I believe that all of our children in our community deserve a quality education. I have remained focused on education and will not gamble with your hard-earned taxpayer monies.
I believe parents are partners in our children's education. I believe in secured campuses to ensure that our students and staff are safe.
I listened to our stakeholders and will continue to do so, to make the best-informed decisions for all.

text: Occupation: Incumbent

WUSD has always been very special to me. I have lived in the Antelope Valley most of my life, and raised my two daughters here, both of whom attended WUSD schools. My family has owned and operated a small business in our community for nearly 50
years. Growing up in the world of small business has taught me it takes hard work and perseverance to achieve success.

WUSD students, teachers and administrators are doing amazing things, even under the most difficult of circumstances. Despite the challenges we have faced, our schools are doing noteworthy things and have received many state and national awards.

It takes a commitment and willingness to work as a team, even when respectfully disagreeing. These past two years have shown us challenges that none of us could have seen coming, but I remained committed to being a collaborative, level-headed and engaged board member representing our children, teachers, parents, and taxpayers to ensure that Westside continues to be the school district of choice in the Antelope Valley.
I remain passionate about providing a safe, positive, and quality learning environment for our children! I humbly ask for your vote to return me to the WUSD Governing Board.

text: As an incumbent Westside Union School District Board Trustee, I am running for re-election to continue delivering a safe, high-quality education that prepares every child for success. With professional experience in aerospace engineering, I bring a problem-solving, results-oriented, systems-thinking approach to board service.
Academic Excellence First

Raising student achievement remains essential. Building on our schools' distinctions, we must continue improving proficiency in reading and math through evidence-based instruction, targeted support, and high expectations for all students.
Empowering Parents

Parents are children's first teachers. I support enhanced transparency and policies that better inform families about educational materials and curriculum. I will promote greater involvement through PTAs, School Site Councils, and open communication.
Safe Campuses
Safety enables learning. I strongly support the addition of School Resource Officers in partnership with Lancaster Police to protect students and build positive relationships.
Responsible Stewardship
I will keep advocating prudent budgeting focused on classrooms while listening to families, educators, and our community.
Together, we can strengthen academic performance, parental engagement, and safety across our K-8 schools. I respectfully ask for your continued support and vote.

text: Age: 43
Occupation: School Administrator

As a dedicated educator and school administrator, I am honored to seek a position on the Westside Union School District Board. Having served the district as both a teacher and administrator, I have experienced the opportunities and challenges facing the students, families and staff.

Throughout my career, I have been committed to creating safe, supportive learning environments where every student can succeed. I believe strong schools are built through collaboration, fiscal responsibility, transparency, and meaningful partnerships with parents, educators and the community.

As a current school administrator, I understand the importance of balancing educational excellance with responsible stewardship of district resources. My experience has given me the knowledge to make thoughtful, student-centered decisions that support academic achievement while preparing students for future success.

If elected, I will listen to our community, advocate for students and staff, and work to ensure every child has access to high-quality education. Together we can continue building on Westside Union School District's strengths while meeting the needs of today's learners and tomorrow's leaders.
